---
title: "Using the tool"
---

## The guided menu

`esa` with no arguments opens a menu. The top shows, for each service, whether its inputs are in the store and the state of each
stage (done, outdated or not run), with the time it took. The menu then offers to run accounts, list and fetch inputs, open the
outputs folder or check the installation. When it runs accounts it asks which services, which years and how much to run, and it
prints the command that does the same, so the menu also teaches the commands below.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|:---|:-----|
| `esa` | Guided menu |
| `esa status [services]` | Inputs in the store and state of each stage. `--json` for scripts |
| `esa inputs [services]` | Every input, its source and whether the store holds it |
| `esa fetch [datasets or services]` | Downloads what is missing into the store. `--dry-run` lists it first |
| `esa run [services]` | Runs the stages that are not up to date, then renders the reports |
| `esa run carbon -s accounts` | Runs one stage only (repeat `-s` for several) |
| `esa run --years 2018,2024` | Limits a run to some reporting years |
| `esa run --force` | Runs every stage again |
| `esa run pollination --method original` | Runs crop pollination as it was before the revision of 2026, into `outputs/pollination_original/`. `status`, `report` and `clean` take the same option |
| `esa report [services]` | Renders the reports from the last run. `--formats html,pdf` |
| `esa doctor` | Checks the installation, folders, free disk, memory, Quarto and Copernicus keys |
| `esa clean [services]` | Deletes the working files of a service. `--outputs` also deletes its products |

: Commands. Run any command with `--help` for its options. {#tbl-commands}

Exit codes are 0 for success, 1 for a failed check or an unexpected error, 2 for invalid usage and 3 for inputs or settings that
cannot be used.

## Stages

Each service runs in stages, in order, and each stage reads what the earlier ones wrote. A stage reruns when its code, the tool
version or the years change, and the stages after it rerun as well.

| Service | Stages |
|:--|:----|
| Crop pollination | `prepare`, `model`, `sdm`, `accounts`, `maps_1km`, `maps_100m` |
| Wood provision | `prepare`, `accounts`, `maps_1km`, `maps_100m` |
| Carbon sequestration | `prepare`, `accounts`, `maps_1km`, `maps_100m` |

: Stages of each service. The code annex of each service page describes them. {#tbl-stages}

## Folders and settings

The tool works with three folders, which `esa.toml` in the working folder can set, as can the variables `ESA_STORE`,
`ESA_OUTPUTS` and `ESA_WORK`.

```toml
[esa]
store = "store"       # inputs, as fetched. Shared by all services
outputs = "outputs"   # products, one folder per service
work = "work"         # intermediate files, safe to delete
workers = 8           # processes for the raster steps, default from cores and memory
formats = ["html", "pdf", "docx"]
```

The store needs about 5 GB, the outputs about 12 GB for the three services, and the work folder a few GB while the 100 m maps
are written.
